name: goc-creator
description: Góc Creator — 3 landing page + CMS + affiliate, chạy trên Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: npm run build:pages && npm run build:admin && npm run build:aff
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env production
